stripline.note: Inconclusive: one solve's energy fell only 0 dB in 60,000 steps (the solver warns the result is approximate). The two ground sheets stop one cell short of the PEC box, so they are not tied together and the box rings. NobuRF needs vias (or ground sheets that reach the walls) to model stripline.
